Its multimodal proprietary AI processes branded+Influencer+UGC video text, audio, Imagery into product-level metadata powering shopper agents, campaign agents, and insights agents. Vyrill powers in-video-"search, personalization, SEO/AEO, recommendations & Buy Now". Shoppers can instantly find “moments that matter” with clips+ summaries.

records.name: Perf
records.tagline: Verify and correct AI outputs before users see them
records.description: Perf is an AI correction layer for teams shipping AI products. It sits between your app and your models, checks every output against your rules, and fixes or blocks issues before users see them. We’re opening a limited closed beta for teams dealing with hallucinations, incorrectly parsed JSON, policy violations, or unreliable AI responses.

records.name: Kunstig Aero
records.tagline: Autonomous air traffic control for airport operations
records.description: Kunstig Aero is building an autonomous air traffic control system, starting with airport infrastructure that gives operators visibility into aircraft positions, voice communications, and ground movements before expanding into alerts and autonomous control.

records.name: Hestus
records.tagline: Native CAD autocomplete — 2.5x faster, 4x fewer clicks
records.description: Hestus brings autocomplete to CAD, helping teams move 2.5x faster with 4x fewer clicks. No clunky prompts or workflow pivots. Hestus lives natively in your CAD environment, predicting your next move by understanding design intent in real-time. Just design as you always do, only much faster.

records.name: AllMind AI
records.tagline: AI research terminal for institutional investors
records.description: AllMind AI combines filings, broker research, internal documents, news, and workflow automation in one research terminal. It helps institutional finance teams produce investment memos and due diligence work faster.

records.name: KYXStart.Ai
records.tagline: KYC, KYB, and payment verification API
records.description: KYXStart provides a unified API for identity, business, payment, telco, fraud, and AML verification. It is aimed at regulated teams that need to reduce fraud and approval friction across global onboarding flows.

records.name: Vocadian
records.tagline: Predictive voice AI for workforce fatigue risk
records.description: Vocadian uses voice biomarkers to assess fatigue risk and support safety programs for frontline teams in transportation, construction, mining, oil and gas, and aviation.

records.name: Boxtree, Inc.
records.tagline: Mixed reality tabletop sandbox for XR on Quest & Vision Pro
records.description: Boxtree builds mixed reality tabletop games with infinite replayability for the XR platform shift. Table Space on Meta Quest and Apple Vision Pro, is the ultimate tabletop sandbox, where you can play and create your own tabletop games with friends. Coming soon to Steam Frame and a few more surprise devices later this year :)

records.name: Pickle
records.tagline: Personal memory layer that works across AI apps
records.description: Pickle turns a user's conversations, actions, and learned context into a portable memory layer for AI. Its system helps assistants recall patterns, personalize responses, and keep private memory under user control.

records.name: Mona
records.tagline: Automating business capital access with AI agents
records.description: Mona is automating small business capital access with AI agents – making it easier for businesses to find, apply to, and secure the $1.6T+/year in loans, grants, and government funding. Mona intelligently scans the funding ecosystem, matches businesses to best-fit opportunities, and auto-generates applications while providing AI-driven financial guidance and capital management.

records.name: Lety.ai
records.tagline: The revenue layer for AI agencies. | White-Label Platform
records.description: The infrastructure behind AI agencies. Build, brand, and bill AI agents at scale. White-label platform with 600+ MCP integrations, multi-tenant architecture, and worldwide billing. Deploy vertical AI agents for any industry in minutes. Earn margin on every AI conversation. 250+ agencies in 15+ countries. No code.

records.name: Motai
records.tagline: AI-powered commerce and financing platform for motorcycles
records.description: Motai helps shoppers buy, finance, rent, and sell motorcycles online, with inventory search, quotes, and ownership transfer workflows built into one marketplace.

records.name: Parakeet Risk
records.tagline: Third-party risk monitoring for industrial teams
records.description: Parakeet Risk monitors contractors and suppliers around the clock, automates vendor screening, and gives industrial operators audit-ready views of third-party risk across their supply chain.

records.name: Awesomic Studio
records.tagline: Multi-agent AI that designs landing pages and presentation
records.description: Most AI website builders give you a template with your logo on it. Awesomic Studio gives you a design team. A swarm of specialized AI agents - research, copy, art direction, UI, code - collaborate to ship a real landing page in minutes. Powered by Anthropic and trained on 30,000+ shipped design tasks from the Awesomic marketplace. Made for founders who ship.

records.name: Scoutz
records.tagline: Basketball recruiting app for athletes and scouts
records.description: Scoutz gives athletes a profile, verified scout reviews, recruiting matches, and AI tools to help them get discovered by teams.

records.name: Hatchproof
records.tagline: Behavioral performance analytics for lean teams
records.description: Hatchproof turns signals from Slack, email, meetings, and wearables into early warnings on churn, mis-hires, and performance drift for founders and CEOs.

records.name: 409.ai
records.tagline: Fast 409A valuation for startups
records.description: 409.ai helps startups complete 409A valuations faster with guided workflows, integrations, and lower-cost valuation support.

records.name: LetMeDoIt.org
records.tagline: Decision-making support app for independent living
records.description: LetMeDoIt helps people with disabilities, seniors, and their support networks organize decisions, invite trusted supporters, and manage budgets together in one app. It offers a structured workflow for breaking decisions into steps, sharing input, and building confidence without giving up autonomy.

records.name: Sommos
records.tagline: Digital savings and credit tools for LatAm finance
records.description: Sommos builds digital savings groups, credit, and goal-based finance products for banks and merchants, combining local savings behaviors with data and AI.

records.name: Journey AI by Journey Foods
records.tagline: Supply chain agents and data for consumer product teams
records.description: Journey AI gives consumer brands AI tools for ingredient intelligence, cost prediction, and supply chain planning. It is positioned for product development and operations teams managing food and CPG workflows at scale.

records.name: Skill n Depth AG
records.tagline: Skill verification for diving and marine crews
records.description: Skill N Depth manages credentials, diver logbooks, project oversight, and job workflows for occupational diving and marine contracting teams.

records.name: MyARC
records.tagline: Enabling creators to train their communities at scale.
records.description: Creators and consumers are forced to choose between expensive 1:1 coaching or generic mass-market plans. Pricing consumers out of personalised fitness and preventing creators from having scalable businesses. Currently, there is no system to deliver personalized training at scale. MyARC is that system. It automatically personalizes training plans and nutrition. Making personalized fitness affordable and unlocking a scalable business model for creators.

records.name: Wynwood House
records.tagline: Flexible apartment stays across Latin American cities
records.description: Wynwood House lets travelers book furnished apartments and villas for short or long stays, with hotel-style services across major cities in Latin America and beyond.

records.name: Hammock
records.tagline: The only HSA/FSA you can spend on wellness products
records.description: Hammock is an HSA/FSA that just works -- AI expense scanning, integrated wellness coverage, and member perks. We help you find eligible healthcare expenses you're missing and make wellness spending tax-free so gym memberships, supplements, massage, recovery, and more are all 30-50% less.

records.name: Oriane
records.tagline: The perception layer for Marketers and their AIs
records.description: 91% of internet bandwidth is led by videos that your AI does NOT watch... Oriane watches millions of social videos a day, and turns what's on screen, in audio and in captions into a structured intelligence layer for teams and their AI apps to find niche creators, spot content trends, identify viral hooks and more!

records.name: Efektiva
records.tagline: B2B client and supplier verification platform
records.description: Efektiva helps companies verify business customers and suppliers with document review, credit checks, AML screening, and digital contracting. The product is built for risk and operations teams running high-trust onboarding workflows.

records.name: Embryoxite
records.tagline: AI embryo analysis for IVF clinics
records.description: Embryoxite helps fertility clinics predict embryo implantation success with non-invasive AI analysis and a web-based IVF records platform.
